title: Renewables Portfolio Manager
description: Our Business Area (BA) Markets is looking for the right person to fill the position as Renewables Portfolio Manager for our office in Hamburg. The key responsibiltiies are the following: Portfolio Analytics & Value Creation: Analyze renewable energy portfolios and identify key value drivers, optimization opportunities, and commercial risks across power, certificates, and flexibility products. Quantitative Modeling: Develop, maintain, and enhance portfolio valuation models and analytical tools to support commercial decision-making, portfolio optimization, and pricing activities. Capture Rate Analysis: Assess capture rate development and other key drivers impacting the performance of wind and solar portfolios. Risk Assessment & Portfolio Steering: Evaluate portfolio performance and risk exposure under various market scenarios, supporting hedging decisions, portfolio strategies, and risk management activities. Methodology Development: Drive the continuous improvement of valuation approaches, pricing methodologies, analytics frameworks, and portfolio performance metrics. Commercial Decision Support: Provide quantitative insights and recommendations to portfolio managers, originators, and senior management to support deal evaluation, pricing decisions, and portfolio strategy development. Data Management & Reporting: Develop and automate analytical reporting while ensuring the quality, consistency, and transparency of portfolio and market data. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with portfolio managers, analysts, traders, risk managers, originators, back-office, and IT teams to strengthen analytical capabilities and support scalable portfolio management processes. Your profile: We’re looking for someone who combines strong analytical capabilities with a genuine interest in energy markets and renewable energy. You enjoy working with complex datasets, developing quantitative models, and translating analytical insights into commercial recommendations. To succeed in this role, you should also bring: A completed university degree in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Economics, Finance, Data Science, or a related quantitative field. At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in portfolio analytics, quantitative analysis, energy trading, risk management, forecasting, or a similar analytical role within the energy sector. A solid understanding of European power markets, renewable energy business models, and the commercial drivers affecting wind and solar portfolios. Experience in quantitative modeling, valuation methodologies, forecasting, scenario analysis, and data-driven decision making. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex analyses into actionable business recommendations. Experience working with analytical and visualization tools such as Python, Power BI, or similar platforms. A structured and detail-oriented working style combined with a high degree of initiative and ownership. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across commercial, analytical, risk, and technical teams. Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required. German language skills are considered an advantage.

description: Location: Copenhagen, Denmark At Maersk, we're working to enable the transition towards net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2040. New fuels, evolving regulations, and changing customer expectations are reshaping our industry, and our Energy Transition team is at the heart of that transformation. We're looking for a Finance Business Partner to join our Energy Transition Finance team and help support the financial decisions that will shape the future of sustainable shipping. This is not a traditional finance partnering role. You'll work at the intersection of finance, energy markets, green fuels, regulation, and business transformation, partnering with stakeholders across our commercial, trading, origination, operational, and finance communities. What you'll be doing In this role, you'll provide financial insights and decision support across Maersk's green fuel activities. You'll help evaluate opportunities, assess risks, and ensure we make informed decisions as we scale our decarbonization efforts. Your responsibilities will include: Driving performance management, reporting, forecasting, and planning activities Conducting financial, scenario, and sensitivity analyses to support business decisions Supporting financial due diligence for fuel supply agreements and new products Helping stakeholders understand the financial implications of evolving fuel markets and regulations Identifying opportunities to improve reporting, processes, and automation Building strong partnerships across Energy Transition, Energy Markets, and Finance teams Supporting the development of sustainable financial processes for emerging fuels and regulatory requirements Who we're looking for We're seeking someone with strong analytical and business partnering skills, combined with a genuine interest in the energy transition landscape. You may already have experience within energy, fuels, commodities, trading, renewables, sustainability, or a related sector. Equally, you may bring strong finance experience and a track record of quickly building expertise in complex and evolving subject areas. We're particularly interested in candidates who bring: Experience in finance business partnering, commercial finance, FP&A, product control, risk, or a similar analytical role Strong financial modelling and analytical capabilities Experience working with data and tools such as Excel and Power BI The ability to communicate complex topics clearly and influence a diverse range of stakeholders A proactive, curious, and solutions-oriented mindset Comfort navigating ambiguity and solving problems in a fast-changing environment ** Experience within energy markets, fuels, commodities, decarbonization, sustainability, or related industries will be a significant advantage. Why join us? This is a unique opportunity to work on one of Maersk's most strategic priorities and contribute to the decarbonization of global trade. You'll gain exposure to complex commercial decisions, emerging fuel markets, evolving regulation, and senior business stakeholders, while developing expertise in an area that is shaping the future of our industry. Ready to help drive the energy transition? We'd love to hear from you. title: Collections and Recovery Specialist at Volvo Financial Services (Vilnius or Riga)
description: Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. What you will do At Volvo Financial Services you will contribute to the transformation of our company, the transport industry and society at large. The Collections & Recovery Specialist plays an important role in supporting portfolio quality and minimizing credit losses across Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia. The role combines analytical, operational and decision-support responsibilities by monitoring collections performance, preparing portfolio and overdue debt reporting, reviewing contract modification requests, and providing recommendations to support sound credit and collections decisions. The position reports to the Credit Manager at Volvo Financial Services Baltics. Main activities and core responsibilities: • Monitor collections and recovery performance across the Baltic portfolio. • Work with soft collections providers and directly with customers, as needed, to determine cause of delinquency and negotiate payment arrangements. • Prepare and maintain overdue debt (OVD), delinquency and collections performance reports for management. • Ensure data quality and consistency within collections and portfolio management reporting. • Analyze portfolio trends, identify risk areas and recommend corrective actions. • Review customer requests for contract modifications, payment extensions and restructurings. • Perform financial and risk assessment of modification requests and prepare recommendations for approval. • Initiate and handle termination of contracts due to default. • Coordinate Repossession and support Remarketing functions as required. • Support decision-making by providing portfolio, collections and recovery insights. • Monitor recovery performance and support actions aimed at maximizing recovered amounts. • Lead periodic collection meetings to discuss individual accounts and action items. • Drive continuous improvements in collections, recovery and contract administration processes. • Support implementation of new tools, products and business initiatives impacting collections activities. Who are you? In this role, you will bring: • University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. • Minimum 3 years of experience in collections, credit, risk management, accounts receivables or financial analysis. Experience in a customer service or similar environment is an advantage. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. • Ability to assess financial risks and identify appropriate mitigation actions. • Good understanding of leasing and loan products. • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities. • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. • Experience working in an international and multicultural environment is an advantage. • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. • Fluency in Lithuanian or Latvian and advanced level of English. What’s in it for you? We offer a solid package of compensation and benefits, plus you will enjoy: • Joining a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who make customers win. • Opportunity to grow both personally and professionally. • Space to initiate and implement improvements that create value for customers and the business. • Environment where we work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead. • Package of company benefits such as trainings, additional health insurance and more. Salary level: from 2.900€ to 3.600€ per month gross (before withholding taxes) depending on skills and experience. Also, annual bonus program will be applied in accordance with the Company policy. Ready for the next move? If you are a proactive professional with strong analytical capabilities, customer focus and integrity, we would like to meet you. Apply now to join Volvo Financial Services Baltics and help us maintain a healthy portfolio while delivering excellent customer support and sustainable business results. title: Market Risk Analyst
description: We are seeking talented professionals to join our Risk Management team. The market risk team plays a central role in analysing, measuring, managing, and communicating the risks associated with the Asset and Origination portfolios, including related hedging strategies. The team is also responsible for independent analysis and for supporting the implementation of new contracts in our risk systems. Regularly report on the performance (P&L) and risks associated with our Asset and Origination portfolios, providing accurate and timely information to stakeholders. Monitor energy market developments, regulatory changes, and their potential impact on our portfolios. Perform comprehensive risk assessments of transactions and deal structures before execution, identifying key risks and proposing appropriate mitigation measures. Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including originators, portfolio managers, analysts, and credit risk teams, to ensure robust risk management and deal viability. Contribute to the continuous improvement of risk management processes and tools by sharing insights and proposing enhancements. We look for a Market Risk Analyst with the skills to future-proof our business and strengthen our market risk team. Excellent communication skills with the ability to confidently engage with stakeholders. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Norwegian is an advantage but not required This position is suitable for candidates with prior experience in energy markets or risk management, as well as talented graduates with an interest in renewable energy markets.

title: PreMaster-Programm – Managementassistenz im FC-Bereich, Schwerpunkt Controlling (w/m/div.)
description: In dieser Position übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Überwachung der geschäftlichen und finanziellen Aspekte der von Ihrem Team vorgeschlagenen Kosteneinsparungsmaßnahmen. Durch Ihr Verständnis des finanziellen Hintergrunds dieser Veränderungen spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Bewertung des Fortschritts dieser Maßnahmen. Dies erfolgt durch die Analyse der erwarteten Ergebnisse sowie des kommerziellen Status dieser Veränderungen. Bei diesen Aufgaben werden Sie von verschiedenen Teams weltweit unterstützt (Deutschland, Ungarn, Rumänien, USA, Indien und Mexiko). Sie stehen dabei nicht nur in engem Austausch mit Controlling-Teams, sondern auch mit den Bereichen Einkauf, Vertrieb und vielen weiteren Bosch-Einheiten weltweit. Gemeinsam stellen Sie entscheidungsrelevante Finanzinformationen bereit, die für Managemententscheidungen und die Projektsteuerung genutzt werden – insbesondere in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Controlling-Team bei der Erstellung der monatlichen Management-Reports. Ausbildung: Sie müssen ein Bachelorstudium in den Bereichen Statistik, Management, Informatik oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften erfolgreich abgeschlossen haben, dabei deutlich überdurchschnittliche Leistungen erzielt haben und fest beabsichtigen, anschließend ein Masterstudium aufzunehmen. Erfahrung und Kenntnisse: Sie verfügen idealerweise über einen Hintergrund in Datenanalyse sowie Planung & Forecasting. Projektmanagement-Erfahrung ist von Vorteil. Zudem bringen Sie sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel, PowerPoint und Power BI mit. Qualifikationen: Sie sind gut organisiert, teamorientiert, kommunikativ und international ausgerichtet. Sprachen: Englisch auf C1-Niveau ist erforderlich, Deutsch auf B1-Niveau ist von Vorteil.

By understanding the financial background of these changes, you will play an important role in assessing the progress of these measures. This is done by analyzing the expected results as well as the commercial status of these changes. You will be supported in these tasks by various teams around the world (Germany, Hungary, Romania, USA, India and Mexico). You are not only in close contact with controlling teams, but also with purchasing, sales and many other Bosch units worldwide. Together, you will provide decision-relevant financial information that is used for management decisions and project control - especially in collaboration with the controlling team when preparing the monthly management reports. Education: You must have successfully completed a bachelor's degree in the fields of statistics, management, computer science or economics, have achieved significantly above-average performance and firmly intend to subsequently take up a master's degree. Experience and knowledge: Ideally, you have a background in data analysis and planning & forecasting. Project management experience is an advantage. You also have very good knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint and Power BI.

description: , United Kingdom Job Family Group: Trading Jobs Worker Type: Regular Posting Start Date: August 1, 2026 Business Unit: Experience Level: Experienced Professionals Job Description: What’s the role Shell Energy Europe & Environmental Products is seeking a Data Scientist to work within the Market Analysis team to develop and improve our forecasting models. Accurate forecasting of market fundamentals is critical to improved decision making on the trading desk. The analysis team develop and run a wide range of forecasts, using different methods such as machine learning, optimisation. What you’ll be doing Shell Energy Europe is looking to hire a data scientist to support the Power Fundamentals team in building and productionising time series forecasting and optimisation models (stochastic optimisation, dynamic programming, LP/MILP models, etc). This person will have an enthusiasm to learn the inner working of the power market by working in close collaboration with domain experts. They must be able to understand the fundamentals of the power market and translate this into a mathematical model. This requires taking a pragmatic approach to model development, starting with a simple model, and iteratively adding complexity – driven by adding business value in a high-pace environment. This person must be a strong programmer, who is confident in productionising models in the cloud (Azure/AWS) and is comfortable in designing and implementing data ingestion and model deployment pipelines. Responsibilities: Prepare, process, clean and visualize various kind of power, gas, and weather data sets to establish a basis of further analysis. Develop, analyse, and conduct different approaches to forecasts different variables (Demand, wind, solar, prices). Statistical evaluation and validation of different types of forecasts. Build the framework to deploy models in production that will be use every day for trading decisions. Share this framework with the rest of the team to increase the performance of the rest of the team developments. Participate to the conception and development of a computational environment which enable scalability and high computational power. Develop in house optimisation models (stack models, dispatch models). Bring new ideas of models to improve the desk P&L. Delegate and lead some models and infrastructures projects done by teams of high technical people in IT and modelling. What we need from you Your technical skills and experience: Have a graduate qualification in an analytical or science-based discipline e.g., engineering/maths/computer science and ideally a PhD in machine learning, optimisation or equivalent End-to-end experience with data, including querying, aggregation, analysis, and visualization Strong competencies in Python for data analysis using the python data science libraries (Pandas/NumPy/SciPy/Scikit-learn). Strong SQL skills for data retrieval, basic analysis, and data cleansing. Strong knowledge and application of object-oriented design and software best practices in Python Familiarity of cloud architecture, with a focus in deploying and hosting applications in a cloud environment. As a Senior Finance Project Manager , you will have a unique opportunity to work in an exciting international environment. This is an excellent role for an ambitious individual seeking a challenging, leadership-focused, and independent position. You will spearhead strategic initiatives to standardise and optimise the P2P process across Vattenfall, leveraging our ongoing Next Generation ERP S/4HANA transformation. If you are a dynamic and experienced project manager who is eager to drive process development projects and contribute to the organization’s success, we look forward to receiving your application. Your tasks and responsibilities Lead and manage exciting projects within Purchase-To-Pay (P2P) process across Vattenfall’s business units and their geographies. Drive process improvements, automation, and digitalization initiatives. Support the FBS Subledger Leadership Team in strategic planning, structure and follow-up Lead and collaborate cross-functionally to define project scope, timelines, and deliverables, using the Objective & Key Results (OKR) framework. Drive change management and communication activities within FBS and to stakeholders outside FBS Contribute to broader FBS Subledger initiatives including Order-to-Cash (O2C) and Intercompany cost allocations and billing processes. Mentor and guide process experts, providing hands-on support in their project management and execution. You will join the dynamic Central Services team within Finance Business Support (FBS) where you will play a crucial role in driving strategic & process development projects. As a part of our team, you will utilize your analytical capabilities, leadership skills and change management experience to manage complex initiatives. Do not miss out on the opportunity to be a part of a team that is critical to ensuring successful project execution and driving Vattenfall´s growth and success. Location Solna, Katowice, Berlin or Amsterdam Your profile University degree in Economics, Finance, or a related field, with professional experience in finance processes Holistic understanding of the end-to-end Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) process and familiarity with industry best practices Proven experience in project management and knowledge of project steering frameworks Demonstrated ability to lead change management and communication activities Excellent command of English, both written and spoken, is essential Strong leadership qualities, analytical problem-solving skills, and a structured approach, combined with solid project management capabilities High level of self-motivation, strong collaboration skills, and excellent communication abilities Ability to build trust and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders within and outside of FBS For you to fit in this role, we see that you have worked with improvement initiatives related to e.g. process optimisation, and automation in a Shared Services or Finance department for 3-5 years. Or you have worked with similar tasks as a management consultant. You are also an inspiring change agent and communicator.

title: Werkstudent*in / Work Student – New Business & Portfolio Management (m/w/d)
description: Arbeiten im Bereich Origination – New Business & Portfolio Management Als Teil des Front Office von Statkraft schließt das Team „Central European Origination“ nicht-standardisierte, strukturierte und oft komplexe Transaktionen auf den Energiegroßhandelsmärkten ab und erbringt Dienstleistungen für den Marktzugang. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Handelsabteilung von Statkraft und den anderen regionalen Origination-Teams entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Energielösungen für Kunden in ganz Europa. Die Aufgabenbereiche innerhalb des Teams gliedern sich in Origination, Neugeschäft, Direktvermarktung und Portfoliomanagement. Im Bereich Origination sind wir für die Entwicklung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen und Produkte für unsere Vertragspartner (Upstream/Downstream) verantwortlich – von der Entwicklung über die Wirtschaftlichkeitsanalyse, Verhandlung, Vertragsgestaltung und den Vertragsabschluss bis hin zur Umsetzung. Das Team „New Business“ konzentriert sich auf die Entwicklung neuer, wirtschaftlich erfolgreicher strukturierter Produkte, die etablierte Nachhaltigkeitslösungen durch Flexibilität ergänzen. Ein zentrales Thema ist somit die Batteriespeichervermarktung und damit verbundene Produkte. Das Portfoliomanagement gliedert sich in zwei Teams. Das Team „Pricing & Structuring“ strukturiert und bepreist alle nicht standardisierten Rohstoffverträge und steuert die daraus resultierenden Positionen. Unser Portfolio umfasst eine Vielzahl von Marktzugangsverträgen sowie maßgeschneiderte, langfristige Stromabnahmeverträge (PPAs) und weitere nicht standardisierte, flexible und strukturierte Großhandelsprodukte, wie etwa Verträge zur Batterieoptimierung. Ein Schwerpunkt im Bereich Neugeschäft liegt auf der Entwicklung neuer, wirtschaftlich vielversprechender Lösungen rund um Batterien und erneuerbare Energien. In Unterstützung des Portfoliomanagements haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihre analytischen und programmiertechnischen Fähigkeiten einzusetzen und gleichzeitig Ihr Verständnis für Energie und verwandte Rohstoffe mit Fokus auf erneuerbare Energien zu vertiefen. title: Manager, Deal Finance & M&A
description: Manager, Deal Finance & M&A Location: Cambridge UK Introduction to the Role: AstraZeneca continues to pursue value-enhancing transactions that supplement its product portfolio and development pipeline, and to deliver maximum value from existing assets through the partnerships, collaborations, out- licences and divestments that create value and share risk. AstraZeneca Business Development is a globally integrated organisation with world-class capabilities in strategic planning, search & evaluation, transaction execution and alliance & integration management. It is varied, fast-moving work that offers an unrivalled opportunity to ‘make a difference ’. Within it, Deal Finance leads the financial aspects of Business Development and M&A — valuation, financial analysis and deal structuring — and provides dedicated support in the negotiation and execution of transactions globally. As a valued member of Deal Finance, the Manager provides dedicated financial support in evaluating and executing M&A, licensing, spin-out, collaboration and other structured transactions, working closely with senior Deal Finance colleagues. It is an ideal move for someone with a keen interest in the pharmaceutical industry who thrives in a fast-paced environment — whether taking their first step into industry or broadening their finance business-partnering skills — and who is genuinely excited about using AI to work smarter. Deal Finance is reimagining valuation and deal analysis for the AI era. You’ll use generative AI and automation to accelerate research, due diligence and modelling — freeing you to focus on judgment, insight and the relationships that close great deals. Here, technical skill and sharp commercial judgment are amplified by AI. Main responsibilities Support the construction of business cases, ensuring that all key issues, sensitivities and risks are evaluated and accurately reflected. Build accurate valuation and transaction models, using automation and AI-assisted tooling, that reflect the expected financial statement implications of potential transactions. Use generative AI and advanced analytics to accelerate industry research and company and product analysis, drawing insight from large, unstructured datasets. Provide input into deal structuring, supporting the assessment of transaction value and financial terms, including review of contracts and term sheets for their financial implications. Support financial due diligence, coordinating with AZ tax, accounting and treasury experts as required . Present findings, alongside a senior Deal Finance colleague, to AZ senior management and other internal decision-making bodies, and support the preparation of financial sections of papers and briefings. Work across multiple deals at different stages of the deal cycle, using excellent time management and prioritisation. Help embed AI and automation within Deal Finance, sharing what works and building reusable tools and templates. Essential requirements A strong academic and professional foundation — degree from a leading university, plus ideally a relevant quantitative or financial qualification (ACA, CFA, MBA or equivalent), or working towards one . Financial fundamentals — a solid understanding of cash vs. profit and of value-based cashflow metrics, plus a working knowledge of relevant technical accounting principles. Financial analysis and modelling — strong financial analysis, valuation and financial-modelling skills (particularly MS Excel), with confident, clear storytelling. Data analysis — the ability to collate, clean and analyse large datasets to surface the key drivers of value and risk . AI curiosity — comfort adopting new technology using AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, research and modelling, paired with the judgment to challenge and validate their output. A compelling communicator — able to convey financial recommendations to both financial and non-financial audiences in a concise, collaborative and impactful way. Energetic, resilient and tenacious — able to manage multiple projects under tight timelines in a fast-paced environment, working both independently and as part of multifunctional transaction teams. Genuine curiosity — a keen interest in business development, emerging technology and the wider pharmaceutical industry. Desirable requirements Industry experience — ideally within a Biotech or Pharma corporate environment. Hands-on AI and data tooling — experience with generative AI, machine learning,

title: Controller (w/m/div.)
description: Du übernimmst das Standort-Controlling und betreust eigenverantwortlich das Facility Management am Standort Arnstadt aus kaufmännischer Sicht. Hierbei bist du zudem für die administrative Erstellung und Pflege von Standard-Mietverträgen zuständig. Als zentraler Ansprechpartner arbeitest du eng mit der zentralen Bosch-Buchhaltung und der internen Abteilung im Bereich des Anlagevermögens zusammen. Die Organisation, Durchführung und Dokumentation der physischen Anlageninventur liegt in deiner Verantwortung. Du fungierst als Unterstützung für die zentrale Bosch-Buchhaltung bei Fragestellungen rund um die Kreditorenbuchhaltung und unterstützt bei der Klärung von Kreditorenrechnungen. Du führst das operative Projektcontrolling durch und verantwortest die regelmäßige und präzise kaufmännische Ermittlung unfertiger Erzeugnisse und Leistungen. Im Vertretungsfall übernimmst du zuverlässig die Erstellung des Bosch-internen Monatsabschlusses. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für alle Themen bezüglich der Unternehmensversicherungen am Standort und übernimmst die kaufmännische Prüfung sowie die Verwaltung von Lieferantenbürgschaften. Wir bieten dir den Freiraum, eigene Ideen einzubringen, bestehende Prozesse zu hinterfragen und Veränderungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre (BWL) mit Schwerpunkt Controlling, Finanzen oder Rechnungswesen oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Qualifikation (z. B. IHK Betriebswirt) Berufserfahrung: wünschenswert ist eine einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Standort-, Werks- oder Projektcontrolling sowie fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Accounting/Rechnungswesen – idealerweise gesammelt im Konzernumfeld Fachkompetenz: Fundiertes Wissen im Bereich der Bilanzierung (IFRS/HGB) bezüglich des Anlagevermögens und der Bewertung unfertiger Leistungen (WIP). Erste Erfahrungen im Vertragsrecht (Mietverträge, Bürgschaften) sind von Vorteil. IT-Kenntnisse: Sehr sicherer Umgang mit SAP (R3) sowie den gängigen MS Office-Anwendungen (insbesondere Excel). Persönlichkeit: Analytisches und unternehmerisches Denkvermögen, ausgeprägte Zahlenaffinität und eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise. Du bist kommunikationsstark, durchsetzungsfähig und schätzt die Arbeit an wichtigen internen Schnittstellen. Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
description_en: You will be responsible for site controlling and will be responsible for facility management at the Arnstadt location from a commercial perspective. You are also responsible for the administrative creation and maintenance of standard rental agreements. As a central contact, you will work closely with central Bosch accounting and the internal fixed assets department. The organization, execution and documentation of the physical asset inventory is your responsibility. You act as support for the central Bosch accounting department with questions relating to accounts payable accounting and assist in clarifying vendor invoices. You carry out operational project controlling and are responsible for the regular and precise commercial determination of unfinished products and services. We truly care about the customer’s business in terms of up-time, safety, productivity and of course 100% green energy supply. The energy transition will not come for free – but we are committed to support this transition by hard and dedicated work. So - what are we looking for in this specific role? Volvo Energy is providing a highly qualified digital platform, an Energy Management System (EMS), to control our Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS). We are now looking for Senior OT Network & Systems Engineer that will support in establishing cyber secure connectivity towards BESS units and the BESS digital twin using the appointed Volvo Energy Site Controller. As the energy space rely on standards for interoperability between energy systems, like Modbus, IEC 60870-5, 61850 and DNP-3, you make sure that the IoT Edge solution is designed according to cyber security standards. You also ensure cyber secure connectivity to the Volvo Energy EMS solution via MQTT/OPC-UA as defined by the Volvo Energy target architecture. You will work closely together with several different qualified teams to help design and build the solution and report functionally to the Volvo Energy Head of Enterprise architecture. Key Responsibilities In this role, you’ll take the lead in shaping the OT network architecture that powers our BESS units around the world. You’ll design secure, scalable network environments—everything from segmentation and VLAN structures to DMZ zones and redundancy strategies—both for our own products and for customer sites. As the technical owner of our OT networking landscape, you’ll create and maintain clear, high‑quality diagrams and documentation that bring structure to complex systems and ensure smooth integration with cloud platforms and external SCADA/EMS solutions. A big part of your work will center around cybersecurity. You’ll define modern firewall rulesets built on IEC 62443 and zero‑trust principles, validate safe communication paths for industrial protocols like Modbus, and take full responsibility for the lifecycle of our OT firewalls. That includes firmware updates, patching strategies, redundancy testing, vendor coordination, and the automated deployment of configurations across our global BESS fleet using FortiManager. You’ll also play a hands-on role in our production environments—diving into troubleshooting, leading root‑cause analysis, and contributing to cybersecurity assessments and audits that strengthen our defenses. Collaboration will be at the heart of your everyday work. You’ll partner with engineering teams at our assembly plants to ensure firewalls are configured correctly from the moment a unit is built, and you’ll work with Digital/IT teams to define secure, future‑proof IT–OT demarcation points. Along the way, you’ll also share your expertise with junior engineers and project teams, helping them grow while raising the overall technical bar. description: Do you enjoy driving business performance from a central finance position? Are you an experienced finance professional who can turn complex financial data into strategic insights? Do you thrive in a role where you oversee the bigger picture, steer reporting processes, and support senior management with decision-making? We are looking for a Business Controller to join the Business Control team within Vattenfall's rapidly growing E-Mobility Business Unit. In this central controlling role, you will be responsible for providing insights into the overall financial performance of the Business Unit. You will act as a key partner to senior management, ensuring high-quality financial reporting, forecasting, planning, and performance steering across multiple countries and business areas. Working closely with Business Control colleagues, Finance teams, and senior stakeholders, you will help translate financial results into actionable insights that support the continued growth and development of Vattenfall's E-Mobility business. What will you do? As Senior Business Controller, you will play a key role in steering the overall financial performance of the E-Mobility Business Unit and ensuring a reliable and efficient reporting framework. You will: Coordinate and steer the monthly performance reporting cycle for the overall Business Unit. Consolidate financial results across countries, functions, and business areas into clear management reporting. Deliver insights and analyses on business performance, key value drivers, risks, and opportunities. Lead forecasting activities and translate business developments into reliable financial outlooks. Drive the annual budget and business planning process for the Business Unit. Support senior management with strategic analyses, business cases, and decision-making. Further develop and improve reporting standards, controlling processes, and governance frameworks. Ensure consistency, accuracy, and transparency in financial reporting and performance measurement. Collaborate closely with Business Controllers, Accounting, and Finance teams across different countries. Identify opportunities to automate and enhance reporting tools, KPIs, and management information. Contribute to cross-functional improvement initiatives that support the continued growth of E-Mobility. You will report to the Director of Business Control E-Mobility and work closely with stakeholders across multiple countries and disciplines. Who are you? You are able to combine strong analytical capabilities with a strategic mindset and enjoy understanding how financial performance connects to broader business objectives. You are comfortable working with large amounts of data, creating structure in complex environments, and translating financial outcomes into meaningful insights for senior stakeholders. You can switch effortlessly between detailed financial analysis and high-level performance discussions. With a proactive and collaborative approach, you build strong relationships across the organisation and contribute to continuous improvement. We believe you bring: At least 7 years of experience in Business Controlling, Financial Controlling, FP&A, Corporate Finance, or a similar finance-related role. A master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. Experience with consolidated reporting, forecasting, and business planning in a complex international organisation. Strong analytical and financial modelling skills. Experience working with senior stakeholders and management teams. The ability to translate complex financial information into clear and actionable recommendations. Advanced Excel and presentation skills; experience with SAP and reporting tools is highly valued. Full professional proficiency in English. Experience within the utilities, energy, infrastructure, or other asset-intensive industries is considered an advantage. Location: Berlin, Stockholm or Amsterdam

description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

HUB Controller-Americas

You will help to set business strategy in line with wider division and product group strategies. In this role you will provide key support to the business, ensuring accurate tracking and processing of all transactions. You will translate business strategy into plans and establish measurable targets, evaluate the financial implications of various strategic decisions, identify risks and recommend actions.

This position is open to remote candidates (#LI-Remote) located in the Western and/or Southern United States. The incumbent most be available to travel in these regions to support the business requirements and work closely with business leaders.

Your responsibilities in this role:

  • Contributes to the definition of the strategy for the South & West Field Service Regions as well as our DAC business. Serves as the key partner for the relevant business leader in determining strategy for area of responsibility, aligning with wider strategy, and implementing actions as needed.

  • Translates strategy into business plans and establishes measurable targets. Oversees the business planning and forecasting process for the area of responsibility and serves as the interface of the plant to Global Product Group Controller/Division Controller/Operational Manager and others.

  • Monitors progress and provides insight and analysis to support operational decision-making. Identifies issues and advises management on action plans and operational strategies to resolve.

    Identifies and communicates commercial and financial risks and opportunities from business propositions.

Establishes and oversees processes and tools necessary to obtain transparent and reliable financial data and business information. Ensures high quality of financial data and business information in line with defined standards and financial closing schedules.

Leads the monthly closing process (journal entries / account reconciliations / intercompany billing, etc). Ensure controllership and consistency of accounting processes across the business.


Qualifications for the role:

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or related fields (some consideration for an Associate's Degree in Finance/Accounting with significant relevant experience will also be acceptable)

  • 10 years of experience in a Financial Position, ideally partnering with business leaders, driving and assisting in a mix of financial analyst and accounting responsibilities

  • Experience with ERP Systems required (SAP strongly preferred)

  • Outstanding attention to detail, accuracy, and the ability to multitask

  • Driven, strong leadership, attention to detail, self-sufficient, and excellent customer service attitude

We are looking for you, Head of Global Financial Services to join our Group Finance organization in Neste headquarters in Espoo. As a team, we aim to elevate our financial operations and support Neste's strategic decision-making. Together with your expertise, we can do meaningful work to drive Neste forward. We contribute to Neste’s success by living our values every day: we care, we have courage, we cooperate. We prioritize safety at all times and in every location. We strive to create a positive and impactful work environment. Transformation brings new possibilities and fosters our courage and curiosity. As a global company, we support personal development with versatile learning and career opportunities. Collaboration is key, and we believe in flexible, smart ways of working. We work at the office at least three days a week to ensure seamless teamwork and a sense of belonging. In addition, our benefits for employees in Finland include, for example, a personnel fund as part of the overall remuneration, good occupational health care, a membership in a sickness or health insurance fund and leisure time accident insurance. We also support leisure time activities, e.g. by offering benefits for sports and culture (ePassi). More about the job Your role in our team Leading the Global Financial Services department’s overall performance, including heading your own leadership team of 7 direct reports and an organization of 65+ finance professionals based in Espoo, Finland. Ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting while leading robust financial service processes with strong global internal controls. Maintaining and developing the global service delivery model and fostering strong partnerships with key stakeholders and counterparties. Driving end-to-end process development, continuous improvement, and financial service automation. Participating in IT systems renewals and M&A projects to provide all potential new group companies with scalable, proper financial services. Keys to success in this role Applicable education, e.g., Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance, combined with at least 10 years of relevant work experience. Proven track record in leadership, including providing strategic direction, coaching managers, driving team performance, and fostering global collaboration. Expertise in timely/accurate reporting, internal control frameworks, and running cost management. Solid knowledge of financial processes, systems (especially SAP FI), and accounting principles (IAS/IFRS and Local GAAPs). Experience in end-to-end process development, automation methods (e.g., RPA and AI), and participation in finance IT system projects. Proactive and analytical approach, high adaptability to changing situations, and a strong sense of ownership. Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, positive mindset.
